description: MENSIONE Dashboard Page - Transform frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx into the production MENSIONE dashboard with desktop left panel for live matches, main area for MENSIONE PICKS grid, responsive mobile layout, integrated favorites/combine state management, and clean empty/loading states. Depends on FEAT-002 (components must exist).
steps: 1. Read current frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx completely to understand existing structure and data fetching patterns
2. Read frontend/src/api/client.ts and types.ts to confirm available API methods (getMatches, getMatchPrediction) and response structure (mensione_pick field in MatchPredictionResponse)

3. Create frontend/src/hooks/useFavorites.ts: Custom hook managing favorite match IDs in localStorage. Returns {favorites: Set<string>, toggleFavorite: (id) => void, isFavorite: (id) => boolean}. localStorage key: 'mensione_favorites'

4. Create frontend/src/hooks/useCombine.ts: Custom hook managing combine selections in localStorage. Returns {combineItems: CombineItem[], addToCombine: (item) => void, removeFromCombine: (id) => void, clearCombine: () => void}. CombineItem type: {matchId, marketName, outcome, odds, confidence}. localStorage key: 'mensione_combine'

5. Rewrite Dashboard.tsx: Remove old stats grid structure. Add desktop layout: left panel (250px width) for LiveMatchesPanel, main area for MENSIONE picks. Mobile layout (<768px): hide live panel by default, show horizontal scrolling live matches bar at top or drawer toggle, main area full width for picks

6. In Dashboard.tsx, fetch upcoming matches (7 days) using getUpcomingMatches(7). For each match, fetch prediction using getMatchPrediction(matchId). Filter for matches where prediction.mensione_pick exists. Extract mensione_pick structure from backend response: {market_type, outcome_label, confidence, fair_odds, reasoning}.

7. Map mensione_pick data to MensionePickCard props: homeTeam from match, awayTeam from match, marketName from mensione_pick.market_type (translate to Turkish: 'match_result' -> 'Maç Sonucu', 'btts' -> 'Karşılıklı Gol', etc.), outcome from mensione_pick.outcome_label, confidence from mensione_pick.confidence, realOdds from mensione_pick.fair_odds (note: fair_odds is calculated fair value, NOT bookmaker odds - this is correct per backend architecture)

8. Render MENSIONE picks as grid on desktop (2 columns if space allows, 1 column if narrow), single column on mobile. Use MensionePickCard for each pick. Wire useFavorites and useCombine hooks to card onToggleFavorite and onToggleCombine callbacks

9. Render LiveMatchesPanel in left panel on desktop. Pass mock live match data initially (backend live intelligence not yet available per task context). LiveMatchesPanel should handle empty state ('Şu anda canlı maç yok') and prepare for future real live data integration

10. Update Dashboard.css: .dashboard-container with desktop grid layout (left panel + main), mobile column layout. .live-matches-panel styling (compact, dark surface, fixed width on desktop). .mensione-picks-grid with gap, responsive columns. Loading skeleton styles for cards. Empty state styling: centered, icon, title, description

11. Update Header.tsx: Add 🔔 notification icon button (non-functional placeholder) and 👤 profile icon button (non-functional placeholder) to right side. Update header brand to show MENSIONE (not generic title). Keep mobile menu button on left
12. Update Sidebar.tsx: Change logo text to MENSIONE, tagline to 'Football Intelligence'. Update nav icon for Dashboard to use a better icon if current one doesn't fit new identity

13. Test responsive behavior: Desktop (>1024px) should show left panel + main grid. Tablet (768-1024px) should collapse/compact live panel or show toggle. Mobile (<768px) should show picks first, live matches secondary (horizontal scroll or drawer)
14. Test loading states: Show skeleton loaders while fetching, 'Veriler yükleniyor...' message
15. Test empty states: When no MENSIONE picks available, show 'Şu anda MENSIONE seçimi yok' with explanation
16. Test favorites and combine: Toggle favorite (star changes, localStorage persists), add to combine (checkbox toggles, localStorage persists), refresh page (state restored)

17. Run full verification: `npm run type-check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run dev`, navigate to / (dashboard), inspect layout, live panel, picks, favorites, combine, responsive behavior, accessibility (keyboard nav through all picks and controls)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows left LiveMatchesPanel (desktop) and main MENSIONE picks area
MENSIONE picks fetched from backend mensione_pick field (not fabricated)
MensionePickCard displays each pick with correct market name, confidence, fair odds
Combine selections persist across page refresh (localStorage)
Responsive layout: desktop has left panel, mobile shows picks first with live secondary
Loading states show skeleton loaders with 'Veriler yükleniyor...'
Empty state shows 'Şu anda MENSIONE seçimi yok' when no picks
Header shows MENSIONE brand, 🔔 and 👤 icons (placeholders)
Sidebar shows MENSIONE logo and tagline
verification: Run `npm run test` - dashboard-related tests pass if any exist
Run `npm run dev` and navigate to http://localhost:5173/
Verify left live panel visible on desktop (>1024px width), shows empty state or live matches
Verify main area shows MENSIONE picks grid (if backend has mensione_pick data), or empty state message
Verify clicking star icon toggles favorite, page refresh preserves favorite state
Verify clicking combine checkbox adds to combine, localStorage key 'mensione_combine' exists in DevTools Application tab
Resize browser to mobile (<768px), verify picks appear first, live panel hidden or secondary
Tab through page with keyboard, verify all cards, favorites, combine focusable and operable
Check Network tab: API calls to /api/v1/matches and /api/v1/matches/:id/prediction visible
findings: Successfully implemented MENSIONE Dashboard page with all required features. Created useFavorites and useCombine hooks for localStorage-backed state management (favorites in 'mensione_favorites', combine in 'mensione_combine'). Created LiveMatchesPanel component with EmptyLiveMatchCard for empty state. Updated Header.tsx to add notification 🔔 and profile 👤 icon buttons (placeholders). Updated Sidebar.tsx dashboard icon to 🏠. Completely rewrote Dashboard.tsx to fetch upcoming matches (7 days), fetch predictions for each, filter for mensione_pick, and display in grid using MensionePickCard. Desktop layout shows left LiveMatchesPanel (250px width, sticky) + main MENSIONE picks grid (responsive auto-fill columns). Mobile layout (<768px) hides live panel, shows picks in single column. Added MensionePickResponse type to API types matching backend schema (pick_market, pick_probability, confidence_score, fair_odds, reasoning_factors, etc.). Created parsePickMarket() function to translate pick_market strings (e.g., 'HOME', 'OVER 2.5', 'BTTS YES') into Turkish market names and outcomes. Favorites and combine state persist across page refresh via localStorage. Loading state shows skeleton loaders. Empty state shows 'Şu anda MENSIONE seçimi yok' message. All components keyboard accessible with focus states. TypeScript type-check passes. ESLint passes (with TypeScript version warning, not a blocker). Production build passes successfully. All 50 existing tests pass. Note: Backend currently returns development data with team_id values (not team names), so cards show IDs like 'team_home'/'team_away' - this is expected until real team data integration. Live matches panel shows empty state as backend live intelligence not yet available. Dashboard is fully functional and ready for real backend data integration.
